bench_grouped32_local32_validation.description: Benchmark-only contiguous grouped32 scatter-false validation experiment. Compares exact and optimized scalar loops with Highway vector_stream W=1/2/4, reports operation-originated route counters, and runs untimed adversarial parity probes. Vector-labelled rows fail rather than falling back. It never gathers u64 positions and does not alter production reader routing.

bench_aligners_grid.description: Length × error × algorithm matrix. Iteration counts are bucket-tuned (60 SHORT, 35 MEDIUM, 12 LONG, 3 VERY_LONG, 2 XL) so SHORT cells drive the tight noise floor while XL cells stay inside the per-call budget. Skip noisy×long cells (LONG / VERY_LONG / XL × ONT_LEGACY, HIGH_INDEL_LOW_SUB) — minimap2 itself fails to produce a primary at 8-10% indel rate on >50 kbp pairs.

bench_aligners_curated.description: Curated correctness probes (replaces the legacy `[simple-benchmark]` Catch2 test cases). Asserts both unique-fragment primary correctness and SEAL-style batch behaviour.

bench_aligners_xxl_hifi_relative.description: XXL_HIFI-only non-E2E algorithm comparison. Four samples and nine controlled rows preserve report_76's within-run P50 wall/stage relationships without requiring historical absolute wall times. Every Vulkan-labelled row is a historical partial-GPU probe (CPU work remains) and is explicitly ineligible for all-GPU acceptance.

bench_aligners_xxl_hifi_paired.description: Diagnostic statistically paired companion to bench_aligners_xxl_hifi_relative. It keeps the same nine rows and strict route/correctness proof, but runs one exclusive single-group batch for 11 seeded repetition-major repeats. It reports P50 repeat-wise ratios after retaining repeat zero as first-repeat evidence and excluding it from the 10 steady-state pairs. The 10% wall and 15% partial-Vulkan/stage comparison bands are nonblocking diagnostics because report_76 contains ratio-of-independent-P50 baselines, not this paired estimator; only a baseline captured with this exact schedule may promote them to acceptance. Raw evidence retains every repeat and reports first-repeat separately; first-repeat is not a globally cold measurement because routes share the process/runtime.

bench_aligners_repr_storage.description: Force the 32-bit (K=7 / MEDIUM) and 128-bit (K=27 / XL) MinimizerRepr storage variants. Smaller grid (3 algorithm rows) so the bucket finishes in minutes.

bench_paper_nthash_xxl_hifi_probe.description: Isolated restart-free XXL_HIFI proof for the bounded paper-u32/R7/sum SIMD sketch. The legacy ExactSimd row remains an oracle/debug comparator. Both Paper rows must execute Paper sketch proof plus SIMD chaining, and the Block row must additionally execute Block Aligner SIMD; the strict runner requires exactly one primary mapping with target offset strictly below 15 bp.

bench_aligners_rmq_repro.description: Pinned (LONG, CCS) seed that previously segfaulted on bioseq-RMQ chaining (AVL rebalance bug, fixed in chaining_rmq.cppm). One row, asserts non-zero match count.
